papers.title: Concordance with the MIND diet is associated with lower subsequent epigenetic aging
papers.translated_title: 与MIND饮食的一致性程度较高与后续表观遗传衰老程度较低相关
papers.author: Wang, V. H.-C.
papers.summary: Healthy dietary patterns may influence biological aging, but prospective evidence for the MediterraneanDASH Intervention for Neurodegenerative Delay (MIND) diet is limited. We linked 2013 dietary data to 2016 DNA methylation measures in 1,740 Health and Retirement Study participants. Per 1-s.d. higher MIND score, adjusted differences were -0.4 years for PhenoAge acceleration (95% CI -0.8 to -0.1), -0.3 years for GrimAge acceleration (-0.5 to -0.1) and -0.0054 for methylation Pace of Aging (-0.0098 to -0.0010); all false-discovery-rate q[≤]0.026. Associations persisted after body-mass-index adjustment and selection weighting. Targeted maximum likelihood estimates were concordant with the conventional models, whereas causal forests evaluated in held-out and repeated-split samples found no reproducible evidence that specific subgroups of participants benefited more than others. Greater MIND adherence was associated with lower subsequent epigenetic aging across complementary measures, supporting molecular aging as an intermediate phenotype for diet-aging research.
papers.translated_summary: 健康的饮食模式可能影响生物学衰老，但关于地中海-DASH神经退行性延迟干预（MIND）饮食的前瞻性证据有限。我们将2013年的饮食数据与2016年的DNA甲基化测量数据在1740名健康与退休研究参与者中进行了关联分析。MIND评分每提高1个标准差，校正后的差异为：PhenoAge加速-0.4年（95% CI -0.8至-0.1），GrimAge加速-0.3年（-0.5至-0.1），甲基化衰老速度-0.0054（-0.0098至-0.0010）；所有错误发现率q≤0.026。在体质指数校正和选择加权后，这些关联仍然存在。靶向最大似然估计与传统模型一致，而在留出样本和重复分割样本中评估的因果森林未发现可重复的证据表明特定参与者亚组比其他亚组获益更多。更高的MIND依从性与后续多项互补指标所反映的表观遗传衰老程度较低相关，支持将分子衰老作为饮食-衰老研究的中间表型。

papers.title: Comparative effectiveness of digital health interventions for low back pain: systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
papers.translated_title: 数字健康干预对下背痛比较效果：随机对照试验的系统评价与网络荟萃分析
papers.author: Chen, R.
papers.summary: Objective To determine the comparative effectiveness of different digital health interventions for adults with low back pain. Design Systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials. Data sources PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), CINAHL, APA PsycINFO, ClinicalTrials.gov, and the World Health Organization International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (WHO ICTRP), from inception to 19 March 2026 (updated to 8 August 2026). Study selection Randomised controlled trials enrolling adults with low back pain. Interventions were classified as telemedicine, web-based applications (Web-App), mobile applications (Mobile-App), virtual reality (VR), exergaming, biofeedback devices, face-to-face care, and control. Paired reviewers independently screened records, extracted data, and assessed risk of bias using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool. Methods Frequentist random-effects network meta-analyses synthesised pain intensity and physical function (primary outcomes), and pain-related fear avoidance, health-related quality of life, self-efficacy, anxiety, and depression (secondary outcomes), assessed at post-intervention (from the end of treatment to < 2 months post-intervention), short-term ([≥]2 to <6 months), mid-term ([≥]6 to <12 months), and long-term ([≥]12 months) follow-up. Effects were reported as standardised mean differences with 95% confidence intervals. Transitivity was examined across potential effect modifiers, and Confidence in Network Meta-Analysis (CINeMA) informed confidence ratings. Results Ninety-two reports representing 84 trials involving 11 649 participants were included. At post-intervention, compared with control, VR showed the largest estimated reduction in pain intensity (SMD -1.43, 95% CI -1.87 to -0.98; moderate confidence) and improvement in physical function (-0.86, -1.45 to -0.26; very low confidence). VR was also associated with lower pain-related fear avoidance (-1.14, -1.68 to -0.61) and better health-related quality of life (0.97, 0.57 to 1.36) (both moderate confidence). Exergaming, Mobile-App, Web-App and telemedicine were also associated with lower pain intensity, while Mobile-App, Web-App, telemedicine, and biofeedback devices were associated with better physical function. For self-efficacy, exergaming (0.77, 0.05 to 1.49) showed favourable post-intervention effects, although confidence in this estimate was very low. No intervention showed a clear effect on anxiety, with confidence ranging from very low to moderate across comparisons, whereas telemedicine was associated with lower depression (-0.22, -0.44 to 0.00; low confidence). Networks became progressively sparse at later follow-up, and evidence of sustained effects was inconsistent across interventions and outcomes. Global inconsistency was detected in the post-intervention pain-intensity network, with local inconsistency identified for selected exergaming comparisons, and substantial heterogeneity was present in several networks. Conclusions Among adults with low back pain, VR showed the largest estimated post-intervention effects versus control for pain intensity, physical function, pain-related fear avoidance, and health-related quality of life, although comparative effects differed across outcomes. Self-efficacy showed favourable estimates for selected interventions, whereas evidence for anxiety and depression was limited. Evidence beyond treatment completion was increasingly sparse, and confidence in many network estimates was low or very low; firm comparative recommendations therefore remain premature. Systematic review registration PROSPERO CRD420261339841
papers.translated_summary: 目的 确定不同数字健康干预对成人下背痛的比较有效性。设计 随机对照试验的系统评价与网络荟萃分析。数据来源 PubMed、Embase、Cochrane对照试验中心注册库（CENTRAL）、CINAHL、APA PsycINFO、ClinicalTrials.gov以及世界卫生组织国际临床试验注册平台（WHO ICTRP），检索时间自建库至2026年3月19日（更新至2026年8月8日）。研究选择 纳入成人下背痛患者的随机对照试验。干预措施分类为远程医疗、基于网络的应用程序（Web-App）、移动应用程序（Mobile-App）、虚拟现实（VR）、体感游戏、生物反馈设备、面对面照护和对照。由两名评价者独立筛选记录、提取数据，并使用Cochrane偏倚风险2工具评估偏倚风险。方法 采用频率学派随机效应网络荟萃分析，综合疼痛强度和躯体功能（主要结局），以及疼痛相关恐惧回避、健康相关生活质量、自我效能、焦虑和抑郁（次要结局），评估时间点为干预后（从治疗结束至干预后<2个月）、短期（≥2至<6个月）、中期（≥6至<12个月）和长期（≥12个月）随访。效应以标准化均数差及95%置信区间报告。在潜在效应修饰因素间检验传递性，并采用网络荟萃分析置信度（CINeMA）进行置信度评级。结果 共纳入92篇报告，代表84项试验，涉及11 649名参与者。在干预后，与对照相比，VR在疼痛强度上显示出最大的估计降低效应（SMD -1.43，95% CI -1.87至-0.98；中等置信度），并在躯体功能上显示出改善（-0.86，-1.45至-0.26；极低置信度）。VR还与较低的疼痛相关恐惧回避（-1.14，-1.68至-0.61）和较好的健康相关生活质量（0.97，0.57至1.36）相关（两者均为中等置信度）。体感游戏、Mobile-App、Web-App和远程医疗也与较低的疼痛强度相关，而Mobile-App、Web-App、远程医疗和生物反馈设备与较好的躯体功能相关。对于自我效能，体感游戏（0.77，0.05至1.49）在干预后显示出有利效应，尽管该估计的置信度极低。没有干预措施对焦虑显示出明确效应，各比较的置信度从极低到中等不等，而远程医疗与较低的抑郁相关（-0.22，-0.44至0.00；低置信度）。网络在较晚随访时逐渐稀疏，持续效应的证据在不同干预和结局间不一致。在干预后疼痛强度网络中检测到全局不一致性，部分体感游戏比较存在局部不一致性，多个网络存在显著异质性。结论 在成人下背痛患者中，VR在干预后对疼痛强度、躯体功能、疼痛相关恐惧回避和健康相关生活质量方面相对于对照显示出最大的估计效应，但比较效应因结局而异。自我效能在部分干预中显示出有利估计，而焦虑和抑郁的证据有限。治疗完成之后的证据日益稀疏，许多网络估计的置信度为低或极低；因此，作出明确的比较性推荐仍为时过早。系统评价注册 PROSPERO CRD420261339841

papers.title: Exploring sex-dependent responses to anodal tDCS in subacute stroke rehabilitation: a post-hoc analysis of the randomized sham-controlled NETS Trial
papers.translated_title: 探索亚急性卒中康复中阳极经颅直流电刺激的性别依赖性反应：随机假对照NETS试验的事后分析
papers.author: Wolf, S.
papers.summary: Background Upper limb dysfunction is among the most disabling consequences of stroke, yet transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS), an extensively investigated adjunct to motor rehabilitation, has not demonstrated consistent benefit in large randomized trials. Interindividual variability may contribute, and sex is a plausible source given anatomical and neurophysiological differences relevant to tDCS. In this post-hoc, exploratory secondary analysis of the NETS trial, we examined sex as a potential effect modifier of tDCS response across the 90-day follow-up and all three domains of the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF). Methods NETS randomized 119 patients with subacute ischemic stroke to anodal tDCS (1 mA) over the ipsilesional primary motor cortex or sham stimulation alongside standardized rehabilitation. Longitudinal mixed-effects models with autoregressive correlation structures examined treatment-by-sex interactions for the Upper-Extremity-Fugl-Meyer Assessment (UEFMA; body function), Box-and-Block Test (BBT; activity), and Stroke Impact Scale participation domain (SIS; participation). Sensitivity analyses included per-protocol analysis, continuous-time models and three-way sex-by-treatment-by-time interactions. Results Relevant treatment-by-sex interactions were found for the UEFMA and BBT, but not for SIS participation. Women receiving active stimulation improved more than those receiving sham: estimated marginal mean differences: UEFMA 6.0 points (95%-CI 1.2;10.7), BBT 8.4 points (95%-CI 2.4;14.3), whereas no relevant treatment effect was observed in men. Results were similar in intention-to-treat and per-protocol populations. Conclusions This hypothesis-generating analysis suggests that sex may modify the response to tDCS in post-stroke upper limb rehabilitation. Together with similar subgroup signals from other trials, these findings warrant prospective, adequately powered trials with prespecified tests of treatment-by-sex interaction.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 上肢功能障碍是卒中后最具致残性的后果之一，而经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）作为运动康复中广泛研究的辅助手段，在大型随机试验中尚未显示出 consistent 的获益。个体间差异可能有所贡献，而性别是一个可能的来源，因为其与tDCS相关的解剖和神经生理差异。在NETS试验的这项事后探索性二次分析中，我们在90天随访期间以及国际功能、残疾和健康分类（ICF）的所有三个领域内，考察了性别作为tDCS反应潜在效应修饰因素的可能性。方法 NETS将119例亚急性缺血性卒中患者随机分配至患侧初级运动皮层阳极tDCS（1 mA）或假刺激，并联合标准化康复。采用具有自回归相关结构的纵向混合效应模型，检验上肢Fugl-Meyer评定（UEFMA；身体功能）、盒块试验（BBT；活动）和卒中影响量表参与领域（SIS；参与）的治疗-by-性别交互作用。敏感性分析包括符合方案分析、连续时间模型以及性别-by-治疗-by-时间三向交互作用。结果 在UEFMA和BBT中发现了相关的治疗-by-性别交互作用，但在SIS参与领域未发现。接受活性刺激的女性比接受假刺激者改善更多：估计边际均值差异：UEFMA 6.0分（95%-CI 1.2;10.7），BBT 8.4分（95%-CI 2.4;14.3），而在男性中未观察到相关治疗效果。意向治疗人群和符合方案人群的结果相似。结论 这项产生假设的分析提示，性别可能修饰卒中后上肢康复中对tDCS的反应。结合其他试验中类似的亚组信号，这些发现值得开展前瞻性、具有足够把握度的试验，并预先设定治疗-by-性别交互作用检验。

papers.title: Psychological inoculation protects young women in South Africa against HIV prevention misinformation: Evidence from a randomised controlled trial
papers.translated_title: 心理免疫接种保护南非年轻女性免受HIV预防错误信息影响：一项随机对照试验的证据
papers.author: Maughan-Brown, B.
papers.summary: BackgroundMisinformation decreases public confidence in health technologies and willingness to use them. Psychological inoculation, or "prebunking", exposes people to misleading claims before they spread widely and refutes the claims and embedded persuasion tactics. Evidence on its effectiveness for HIV-related misinformation, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa and among young women (a population highly vulnerable to HIV), is limited. MethodsWe conducted a randomised controlled trial (July to October 2025) among 2,163 women aged 18-29 years recruited online in South Africa. Participants were randomly assigned to view two short TikTok-style inoculation videos addressing common myths about an HIV vaccine, or attention-matched control videos on nutrition and diabetes. All participants then viewed multiple false claims presented as social media posts. The primary outcome was intention to receive an HIV vaccine if available (1-10 scale), assessed immediately post-intervention and at three-week follow-up. Secondary outcomes included likelihood of recommending the vaccine; and perceived credibility, emotional impact, and shareability of misinformation claims. We used linear regression models to estimate intervention effects. ResultsMisinformation exposure reduced vaccine intentions by 0.63 points in the control group, while intentions increased by 0.30 points in the intervention group. Controlling for covariates and baseline intentions, post-exposure vaccine intentions were 0.92 points higher in the intervention group (95% CI 0.78, 1.06; p<0.01), a 12% relative increase. Intervention participants were also more likely to recommend the vaccine (+0.74; 95% CI 0.61, 0.88; p<0.01). Inoculation reduced perceived credibility, emotional distress, and sharing intentions across all false claims. Effects persisted at three-week follow-up (vaccine intentions: +0.97; 95% CI 0.78, 1.17; p<0.01). ConclusionBrief, scalable psychological inoculation delivered via social-media-style videos protected young womens HIV vaccine intentions, with effects generalising to novel claims and persisting over three weeks. Prebunking campaigns may safeguard public confidence in other new HIV prevention technologies like lenacapavir.
papers.translated_summary: 背景错误信息会降低公众对卫生技术的信心和使用意愿。心理接种，或称“预先驳斥”，是在误导性说法广泛传播之前让人们接触这些说法，并驳斥这些说法及其嵌入的说服策略。关于其对HIV相关错误信息有效性的证据有限，尤其是在撒哈拉以南非洲和年轻女性（HIV高度易感人群）中。方法我们于2025年7月至10月在南非在线招募的2163名18-29岁女性中开展了一项随机对照试验。参与者被随机分配观看两个类似TikTok风格的简短接种视频，内容针对关于HIV疫苗的常见迷思，或观看在注意力上匹配的关于营养和糖尿病的对照视频。随后所有参与者观看以社交媒体帖子形式呈现的多条虚假说法。主要结局是如果可用时接种HIV疫苗的意愿（1-10分量表），在干预后立即评估并在三周随访时评估。次要结局包括推荐疫苗的可能性；以及对错误信息说法的感知可信度、情绪影响和分享意愿。我们使用线性回归模型估计干预效果。结果暴露于错误信息使对照组的疫苗意愿降低0.63分，而干预组的意愿增加0.30分。控制协变量和基线意愿后，干预组暴露后的疫苗意愿高0.92分（95% CI 0.78, 1.06；p<0.01），相对增加12%。干预组参与者也更可能推荐疫苗（+0.74；95% CI 0.61, 0.88；p<0.01）。接种降低了所有虚假说法的感知可信度、情绪困扰和分享意愿。效果在三周随访时持续存在（疫苗意愿：+0.97；95% CI 0.78, 1.17；p<0.01）。结论通过社交媒体风格视频提供的简短、可扩展的心理接种保护了年轻女性的HIV疫苗意愿，其效果可推广至新出现的说法并持续三周以上。预先驳斥活动可能保护公众对其他新型HIV预防技术（如lenacapavir）的信心。

papers.title: Integrative Multi-Omics Analysis of Molecular Associations and Biological Pathways Underlying Neurodevelopmental Conditions in a Twin Cohort
papers.translated_title: 双胞胎队列中神经发育状况相关分子关联与生物学通路的整合多组学分析
papers.author: Zhang, Y.
papers.summary: Neurodevelopmental conditions (NDCs) arise from complex genetic-environmental interactions, yet their molecular underpinnings remain incompletely defined. We applied an integrative multi-omics approach within a deeply phenotyped twin cohort to identify systemic molecular signatures and pathways associated with NDCs. Our study included 237 twins aged 8-28 years from the Roots of Autism and ADHD Twin Study in Sweden (RATSS), with one or more omics layers available per individual, including serum and cerebrospinal fluid proteomics, urine and fecal metabolomics, blood metallomics, and whole-genome sequencing in a subset of 14 monozygotic twin pairs. Using the DIABLO framework, we identified cross-omics features that distinguish individuals with and without NDCs. The identified features converged on enriched metabolic and immune-related pathways, including purine metabolism, lysine degradation, PI3K-Akt, and MAPK signaling. Several key molecules also showed differential abundance at the single-molecule level in generalized estimating equation (GEE) models. ADA protein, pyrimidine-related metabolites (thymidine, glutamine, and 2'-deoxyuridine), and copper showed suggestive associations within NDC-discordant MZ twin pairs, pointing to potential non-shared condition-related effects, while flavin mononucleotide and manganese associations with NDCs were influenced by shared genetic or familial environmental factors. Our findings indicate that NDC-related molecular alterations manifest across multiple biological layers and tissues, and are detectable through integrative systems-level analysis. Our scalable framework provides critical insights into altered metabolic and immune processes in NDCs and highlights candidate features that may inform future biomarker development and mechanistic research in precision psychiatry.
papers.translated_summary: 神经发育状况（NDCs）源于复杂的遗传-环境相互作用，但其分子基础仍未完全明确。我们在一个深度表型的双胞胎队列中应用整合性多组学方法，以识别与NDCs相关的系统性分子特征和通路。我们的研究纳入了来自瑞典自闭症与ADHD双胞胎研究（RATSS）的237名8-28岁双胞胎，每个个体至少有一个组学层面可用，包括血清和脑脊液蛋白质组学、尿液和粪便代谢组学、血液金属组学，以及14对同卵双胞胎子集的全基因组测序。使用DIABLO框架，我们识别了区分有无NDCs个体的跨组学特征。所识别的特征汇聚于富集的代谢和免疫相关通路，包括嘌呤代谢、赖氨酸降解、PI3K-Akt和MAPK信号传导。若干关键分子在广义估计方程（GEE）模型中也显示出单分子水平的差异丰度。ADA蛋白、嘧啶相关代谢物（胸苷、谷氨酰胺和2'-脱氧尿苷）以及铜在NDC不一致的同卵双胞胎对中显示出提示性关联，指向潜在的非共享状况相关效应，而黄素单核苷酸和锰与NDCs的关联则受到共享遗传或家族环境因素的影响。我们的发现表明，NDC相关分子改变在多个生物学层面和组织中表现，并可通过整合性系统水平分析检测到。我们的可扩展框架为NDCs中改变的代谢和免疫过程提供了关键见解，并突出了可能为未来生物标志物开发和精准精神病学机制研究提供信息的候选特征。

papers.title: Who infected the reported cases? Evidence from 678,482 COVID-19 cases with identified infector collected in routine surveillance in the Netherlands, 2020-2022.
papers.translated_title: 报告的病例是谁感染的？来自荷兰2020-2022年常规监测中收集的678,482例已确定感染者的COVID-19病例的证据。
papers.author: Backer, J. A.
papers.summary: Background During infectious disease outbreaks, characteristics of reported cases are routinely collected. These give information on becoming infected but not on infecting others. We assess whether linking infectees to infectors, together with their characteristics, can help understand transmission. Methods From the start of the COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands, reported cases were asked to identify their most probable infector in routine surveillance, enabling the linking of cases. We assess for the period 27 February 2020 - 11 April 2022 whether the infectees of these transmission pairs are representative of all reported cases, whether the transmission pairs yield verifiable estimates of epidemiological characteristics (here the serial interval), and whether they provide information on transmission that cannot be obtained otherwise. Results Of 8,003,008 reported cases, 678,482 (8.5%) could be linked to their most probable infector. These infectees were largely representative of the reported cases regarding age group, sex, and geographical location. The mean serial interval of 3.6 days (sd 3.4 days) from transmission pairs aligns with literature. Transmissions between age groups largely follow known contact patterns. Most transmissions in September 2021 occurred between persons who were not (fully) vaccinated, indicating the effectiveness of the vaccine, and relatively few between persons with different vaccination status, indicating assortative mixing in vaccination status. Conclusion Transmission pairs can be efficiently collected in routine surveillance, providing insight into disease transmission. The current post-pandemic period provides an excellent opportunity to adjust reporting systems for linking infectees to their most probable infector as preparation for future outbreaks.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 在传染病暴发期间，通常会收集报告病例的特征。这些信息提供了关于感染他人的情况，但不提供关于感染他人的信息。我们评估将感染者与其传染者联系起来，并结合其特征，是否有助于理解传播。方法 自荷兰COVID-19大流行开始以来，在常规监测中要求报告病例识别其最可能的传染者，从而使病例能够联系起来。我们评估2020年2月27日至2022年4月11日期间，这些传播对的感染者是否代表所有报告病例，传播对是否产生可验证的流行病学特征估计（此处为序列间隔），以及它们是否提供无法以其他方式获得的传播信息。结果 在8,003,008例报告病例中，678,482例（8.5%）可以联系到其最可能的传染者。这些感染者在年龄组、性别和地理位置方面在很大程度上代表报告病例。传播对的平均序列间隔为3.6天（标准差3.4天），与文献一致。年龄组之间的传播在很大程度上遵循已知接触模式。2021年9月的大多数传播发生在未（完全）接种疫苗的人之间，表明疫苗的有效性，而不同疫苗接种状态的人之间的传播相对较少，表明疫苗接种状态存在选型混合。结论 传播对可以在常规监测中高效收集，提供对疾病传播的洞察。当前大流行后时期提供了一个极好的机会，调整报告系统以将感染者与其最可能的传染者联系起来，为未来暴发做准备。

papers.title: Variantscape: Retrospective Study of Large Language Model-Based Extraction of Variant-Treatment-Cancer Associations from Published Oncology Abstracts
papers.translated_title: Variantscape：基于大型语言模型从已发表肿瘤学摘要中提取变异-治疗-癌症关联的回顾性研究
papers.author: Wosny, M.
papers.summary: Objectives: Precision oncology relies on accurate interpretation of tumour-detected gene variants, to guide personalised treatment decisions. However, interpretation of variants in context requires extensive information that is often buried within unstructured biomedical literature and obscured by inconsistent nomenclature, making manual retrieval labour-intensive and prone to omissions. In this study, our aim was to evaluate the potential of large language models to extract variant-treatment-cancer associations at scale from published abstracts. Design: We developed Variantscape, a large-scale, automated pipeline and open-access web tool. It integrates traditional natural language processing methods with state-of-the-art large language models to extract, standardise, and analyse co-associations between genetic variants, cancer types, and therapeutic interventions from published biomedical abstracts. Results: From over 3.7 million abstracts published between January 2014 and October 2026, 886,195 articles containing gene names were eligible for extraction. Among these, 37,895 (4.3%) mentioned a variant, cancer type, and therapeutic agent together, covering 11,985 unique variants across 197 cancer types and 547 therapeutic agents. LLM verification against the abstract text confirmed at least one association in 35,224 papers, giving a literature-derived graph of 10,571 nodes and 44,644 verified edges. Canonical alterations in well-studied cancers (e.g., BRAF V600E in melanoma) were strongly linked to established treatments, while several rare variants also emerged with high-confidence literature support. Conclusions: By applying large language models to biomedical literature, Variantscape enables scalable, context-aware extraction of trilateral variant-treatment-cancer relationships. This approach supports early evidence synthesis/hypothesis generation, highlights underrecognized or rare associations for MTB preparation, and offers a practical resource for accelerating discovery and supporting precision oncology research and translation.
papers.translated_summary: 目标：精准肿瘤学依赖于对肿瘤检测到的基因变异进行准确解读，以指导个性化治疗决策。然而，在具体语境中解读变异需要大量信息，而这些信息往往埋藏在非结构化的生物医学文献中，并因命名不一致而难以辨识，使得人工检索费时费力且容易遗漏。在本研究中，我们的目标是评估大语言模型从已发表摘要中大规模提取变异—治疗—癌症关联的潜力。设计：我们开发了Variantscape，一个大规模自动化流程和开放获取的网络工具。它整合了传统自然语言处理方法与先进的大语言模型，从已发表的生物医学摘要中提取、标准化并分析遗传变异、癌症类型和治疗干预之间的共现关联。结果：从2014年1月至2026年10月发表的超过370万篇摘要中，有886,195篇包含基因名称的文章符合提取条件。其中，37,895篇（4.3%）同时提及变异、癌症类型和治疗药物，覆盖197种癌症类型和547种治疗药物中的11,985个独特变异。大语言模型对照摘要文本进行验证，确认35,224篇论文中至少存在一个关联，形成包含10,571个节点和44,644条已验证边的文献衍生图谱。研究充分的癌症中的经典改变（如黑色素瘤中的BRAF V600E）与既定治疗强关联，同时若干罕见变异也出现了高置信度的文献支持。结论：通过将大语言模型应用于生物医学文献，Variantscape能够可扩展、语境感知地提取变异—治疗—癌症三元关系。该方法支持早期证据综合/假设生成，突出用于MTB准备的未被充分认识或罕见的关联，并为加速发现、支持精准肿瘤学研究和转化提供实用资源。

papers.title: TruBlk™ Shilajit Resin Improves Sexual Function in Men with Erectile Dysfunction: A Randomised, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Trial
papers.translated_title: TruBlk™ 喜来芝树脂改善勃起功能障碍男性性功能：一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、多中心试验
papers.author: Yadav, D.
papers.summary: Erectile dysfunction and age-related testosterone decline are common and growing concerns among ageing men, yet current pharmacological options are constrained by tolerability, cost, and reluctance to start hormone-based therapy, leaving a real gap for safe, long-term alternatives. Shilajit, a resinous plant exudate long used in Ayurvedic medicine, is increasingly proposed to fill this gap with its bioactive constituents thought to confer adaptogenic, antioxidant, and androgen-modulating effects. However, clinical support for this use remains thin, with most existing trials small and conducted in healthy men rather than those with diagnosed erectile dysfunction. In this randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter trial (CTRI/2025/07/090919), 100 men aged 35-55 years with mild-to-moderate erectile dysfunction (IIEF erectile function domain score 11-25) and symptoms suggestive of androgen deficiency were enrolled across two sites. Participants received 250 mg twice daily of standardised TruBlk Shilajit resin or matched placebo for 90 days. Primary endpoints, as registered, were change from baseline in IIEF total and domain scores, total and free testosterone and cortisol, and Hypogonadism Impact of Symptoms Questionnaire (HIS-Q) domain scores. Secondary endpoints included nitric oxide, Fatigue Severity Scale (FSS), and Participant and Investigator Global Assessments. Semen parameters were assessed in a subset of participants. IIEF total score improved significantly more in the TruBlk group (+32.1% vs. +13.6%; d=0.67, p=0.005), with significant gains in four of the five domains, namely erectile function, orgasmic function, overall satisfaction, and intercourse satisfaction (d=0.52-0.61, p=0.011-0.044), while sexual desire showed a smaller, non-significant improvement (d=0.44, p=0.109). This was accompanied by significant increases in total testosterone (+46.1% vs. +10.0%; d=0.44, p=0.030) and free testosterone (+37.4% vs. +6.8%; d=0.41, p=0.048). HIS-Q symptom domains showed a similar pattern to IIEF, with Day 90 differences favouring TruBlk in three of five domains (sexual, energy, and sleep; d=-0.59 to -0.82, p<0.02), while cognition and mood showed smaller, non-significant differences (d=-0.46 to -0.49, p=0.06-0.10). Among secondary endpoints, fatigue fell substantially more with TruBlk than with placebo, with FSS scores decreasing by 51.8% vs. 27.4% from baseline, a large between-group effect at Day 90 (d=-1.13, p<0.0001). At Day 90, 56-58% of TruBlk participants were rated "Much" or "Very Much Improved" on global assessment, compared with 12-14% of placebo. Nitric oxide showed no significant between-group difference. In an exploratory semen-analysis subset (n=57), sperm concentration increased with TruBlk relative to placebo ({delta}=0.53, p<0.001), and in a subset of 40 participants assessed for motility, total motility ({delta}=0.63, p<0.001) and progressive motility (d=0.82, p=0.014) also improved. Ninety days of standardised TruBlk Shilajit resin improved erectile function and increased total and free testosterone in men with mild-to-moderate erectile dysfunction, with improvement in several hypogonadism-related symptom domains, reduced fatigue and, in an exploratory subset, improved sperm concentration and motility. These results support standardised Shilajit resin as a promising intervention for sexual dysfunction in a clinically diagnosed population, meriting further clinical evaluation.
papers.translated_summary: 勃起功能障碍和与年龄相关的睾酮下降是老年男性常见且日益受到关注的问题，然而当前的药物治疗选择受到耐受性、成本以及不愿启动激素治疗的制约，为安全、长期的替代方案留下了真实的空白。Shilajit是一种树脂状的植物渗出物，长期用于阿育吠陀医学，越来越多地被提出用于填补这一空白，其生物活性成分被认为具有适应原、抗氧化和雄激素调节作用。然而，支持这一用途的临床证据仍然薄弱，现有大多数试验规模较小，且是在健康男性而非确诊勃起功能障碍的男性中进行的。在这项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、多中心试验（CTRI/2025/07/090919）中，共在两个中心纳入100名年龄35-55岁、患有轻至中度勃起功能障碍（IIEF勃起功能域评分11-25）且伴有提示雄激素缺乏症状的男性。参与者接受标准化TruBlk Shilajit树脂250 mg每日两次或匹配安慰剂，持续90天。注册的主要终点为IIEF总分及各域评分、总睾酮和游离睾酮及皮质醇、以及性腺功能减退症状影响问卷（HIS-Q）各域评分较基线的变化。次要终点包括一氧化氮、疲劳严重程度量表（FSS）以及参与者和研究者总体评估。在部分参与者中评估了精液参数。TruBlk组的IIEF总分改善显著更大（+32.1% vs. +13.6%；d=0.67，p=0.005），五个域中有四个域显著改善，即勃起功能、性高潮功能、总体满意度和性交满意度（d=0.52-0.61，p=0.011-0.044），而性欲显示出较小且不显著的改善（d=0.44，p=0.109）。与此同时，总睾酮（+46.1% vs. +10.0%；d=0.44，p=0.030）和游离睾酮（+37.4% vs. +6.8%；d=0.41，p=0.048）显著升高。HIS-Q症状域显示出与IIEF相似的模式，第90天时五个域中有三个域（性、精力和睡眠；d=-0.59至-0.82，p<0.02）的差异有利于TruBlk，而认知和情绪显示出较小且不显著的差异（d=-0.46至-0.49，p=0.06-0.10）。在次要终点中，TruBlk组的疲劳下降幅度显著大于安慰剂组，FSS评分较基线下降51.8% vs. 27.4%，第90天时组间效应量大（d=-1.13，p<0.0001）。第90天时，56-58%的TruBlk参与者在总体评估中被评定为“明显改善”或“非常明显改善”，而安慰剂组为12-14%。一氧化氮未显示显著的组间差异。在探索性精液分析亚组（n=57）中，相对于安慰剂，TruBlk组的精子浓度增加（{delta}=0.53，p<0.001），在评估活动力的40名参与者亚组中，总活动力（{delta}=0.63，p<0.001）和前向活动力（d=0.82，p=0.014）也得到改善。90天的标准化TruBlk Shilajit树脂改善了轻至中度勃起功能障碍男性的勃起功能，并增加了总睾酮和游离睾酮，同时改善了若干性腺功能减退相关症状域，减轻了疲劳，并在探索性亚组中改善了精子浓度和活动力。这些结果支持标准化Shilajit树脂作为临床确诊人群中性功能障碍的一种有前景的干预措施，值得进一步的临床评估。

papers.title: Reduced POLD3 Expression Induces DNA Damage and Telomere Shortening in Colorectal Cancer Cells: A Potential Mediator of Colorectal Cancer Risk Variants
papers.translated_title: POLD3表达降低诱导结直肠癌细胞DNA损伤和端粒缩短：结直肠癌风险变异的潜在介质
papers.author: Clarkson, E.
papers.summary: DNA Polymerase Delta (Pol {delta}) acts in DNA synthesis and in DNA repair, both important factors in the proliferative nature, longevity, and mutability of cancer cells. The chromosomal region containing POLD3, the third subunit of Pol {delta}, has recently been identified by genome wide-association studies as containing single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) that increase the risk of colorectal cancer (CRC). To explore the effects of changing POLD3 levels that may underly these statistical associations in CRC, we first carried out survival analyses in the Cancer Genome Atlas colon adenocarcinoma cohort. Cox proportional hazards modelling showed higher POLD3 expression to be associated with moderately improved overall survival in the full cohort. This association with survival was clearest in the microsatellite stable (MSS) subgroup. In order to investigate the mechanisms by which lower POLD3 expression may be associated with poorer outcome, we generated CRC cell line models with reduced POLD3 expression levels. Knockdown of POLD3 resulted in reduced proliferative ability and stalling of the cell cycle in S phase, with some apoptosis of CRC cells. Importantly, POLD3 knockdown cells exhibited DNA damage, manifested by double-stranded breaks (DSBs), and upregulation of DSB repair pathways. Reduced POLD3 also correlated with shortened telomeres with disruption of, specifically, the ALT telomeric maintenance pathway. Taken together these observations suggest that lower POLD3 expression can increase genetic instability in CRC cells in the form of DSBs and shortened telomeres and that this might underly the functional effect of CRC risk SNPs in the POLD3 locus in 11q13.4.
papers.translated_summary: DNA聚合酶δ（Pol δ）参与DNA合成和DNA修复，这两个过程都是癌细胞增殖特性、永续性和突变性的重要因素。全基因组关联研究最近发现，包含Pol δ第三亚基POLD3的染色体区域存在增加结直肠癌（CRC）风险的单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）。为了探究改变POLD3水平可能作为这些统计学关联在CRC中的基础所产生的影响，我们首先在癌症基因组图谱结肠腺癌队列中进行了生存分析。Cox比例风险模型显示，较高的POLD3表达与整个队列中总生存期的适度改善相关。这种与生存期的关联在微卫星稳定（MSS）亚组中最为明显。为了研究较低POLD3表达可能与较差预后相关的机制，我们构建了POLD3表达水平降低的CRC细胞系模型。敲低POLD3导致增殖能力下降和细胞周期停滞于S期，并伴有部分CRC细胞凋亡。重要的是，POLD3敲低细胞表现出DNA损伤，表现为双链断裂（DSBs）和DSB修复通路的上调。POLD3降低还与端粒缩短相关，特别是ALT端粒维持通路受到破坏。综上所述，这些观察结果表明，较低的POLD3表达可以以DSBs和端粒缩短的形式增加CRC细胞的遗传不稳定性，这可能正是11q13.4位点POLD3基因座中CRC风险SNP功能效应的基础。
